name: Acolyte 1× rear derailleur
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed 387.5 g for the original RD-M5185M medium-cage steel Acolyte 1×8 rear derailleur with SpringLock clutch, in the 2021 catalogue. This is distinct from the later Ver.2 RD-M5185M-B, whose weight is not transferred.
